items.text: Postgres advisory locks serialize writers per knowledge base so git commits never interleave.
The embedding model is unloaded from memory after an idle timeout and reloaded on the next job.
Bananas are rich in potassium and are a popular breakfast fruit.
how do we stop concurrent git commits
free RAM when embeddings are not running

Every generation is built from one immutable commit, so a reader can always cite the exact bytes it saw.
